newsitem.title: ITALY: Employment in big Italy firms falls yr/yr in July.
newsitem.headline: Employment in big Italy firms falls yr/yr in July.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 500 employees fell 2.3 percent year-on-year in July, the national statistics institute Istat said on Monday.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 76.4 (1988=100) in July, with month on month employment down 0.3 percent.
Hours worked per employee rose 5.1 percent year-on-year, which Istat said reflected two more working days in the month than in July 1995.
The number of people put on temporary lay-off schemes rose 7.4 percent year-on-year.
In the services sector, the employment index stood at 91.4 (1992=100), a fall of 0.9 percent year on year and a rise of 0.2 percent compared with June.
